hero.title: My Digital Resume
hero.description: Tech-savvy, design-minded, and driven by creativity — I love bringing ideas to life in ways that empower people. Whether it's building intuitive interfaces or crafting seamless user experiences, I'm passionate about creating digital solutions that make a real difference.

about.title: Your Next Digital Experience Champion 🏆
about.description: Native Swedish, fluent in English, and remote-ready with a pro home office. Based near Stockholm and familiar with modern tech stacks. Open to full- or part-time opportunities — excited to bring fresh ideas and energy to your team!
about.contentParagraph1: I get tech, but more importantly - I get people! Having built SaaS platforms myself with thousands of users, I understand both the technical challenges and the human needs that drive great digital experiences.
about.contentParagraph2: That's where magic happens: turning complex problems into elegant solutions!
about.contentParagraph3: When I'm not crafting digital experiences, you'll find me building things with my hands (amateur carpenter at heart!) or chasing after my three kids with my wonderful wife. Same attention to detail, different tools!
about.contentParagraph3Mobile: When I'm not crafting digital experiences, you'll find me building things with my hands (amateur carpenter at heart!) or chasing after my three kids with my wonderful wife. Same attention to detail, different tools!

skills.title: My Tech & Design Expertise 💎
skills.description: The perfect blend of technical skills and creative thinking to build amazing digital experiences!

tools.title: Tech Stack & Tools 🛠️
tools.description: Proficient with modern development tools and always eager to explore emerging technologies!

experience.title: My Journey to Digital Excellence 🌟
experience.description: From university experiments to building platforms serving thousands of users — every step has taught me something valuable about design, development, and what makes users truly happy with their digital tools.

items.title: Digital Innovation Enthusiast
items.description: Passionate about emerging technologies and their potential to solve real-world problems. Always exploring the latest in web development, AI integration, and user experience design. The future is digital, and I want to help shape it! 🤖

items.title: Tech Entrepreneur & Platform Builder
items.description: Built and operated multiple digital platforms serving thousands of users across various industries. Deep hands-on experience with user acquisition, retention, technical challenges, and scaling operations. I've lived through every stage - from MVP to scale! 🚀

items.title: Design & User Experience Advocate
items.description: Passionate about great design and smooth user experiences. I spot what works, what doesn't, and most importantly - I care about making it better. Users deserve thoughtful, well-crafted digital experiences! ✨

items.title: Stockholm Tech Community Member
items.description: Active in Stockholm's vibrant tech community. I know the local scene, the culture, and what makes Swedish tech companies special. Remote-ready with an excellent home office setup! ☕

items.title: University Explorer
items.description: Studied IT, Marketing, and Economics at university - education taught me how to learn and think critically, which is invaluable! 📚 But honestly, the real magic happened when I started building actual projects and solving real problems. That's where everything clicked! 🛠️

whySupport.title: Ready to Create Amazing Experiences! ✨
whySupport.description: I've been on both sides - building digital products AND using them! I know what it feels like to struggle with poor UX, and I live for those aha! moments when everything just works perfectly. Let me help your users discover the joy of seamless digital experiences!

contact.title: Let's Create Something Amazing Together!
contact.description: I'd love to chat about joining your team! Whether it's frontend development, UX/UI design, or any role focused on creating exceptional digital experiences, I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to bring my passion for user-centered design to your projects. Let's connect and explore how we could work together!
